integrity: The proof uses the equations exactly as printed in the primary article and an explicit global coordinate change for the memristive model.
The Lyapunov-spectrum conclusion is structural and does not infer asymptotic exponents from finite-time numerical plots.
The packaged checker verifies the algebraic identities and characteristic-polynomial factors with exact rational arithmetic.
scientific_limitations: The result rules out hyperchaos but does not rule out ordinary chaos, hidden chaotic attractors, periodic dynamics, or multistability.
The result concerns the continuous-time ODEs as printed and does not classify the FPGA discretizations as discrete dynamical systems.
No claim is made about the numerical implementation error responsible for the second positive finite-time Lyapunov estimate in the source.
title: A conserved leaf variable rules out hyperchaos in two Sprott-C extensions
